newsitem.title: SPAIN: Businessman killed in Spain Basque region-agency.
newsitem.headline: Businessman killed in Spain Basque region-agency.

text.p: An unidentified gunman shot dead a local businessman in Spain's Basque country on Tuesday, local agency reports quoted the Interior Ministry as saying.

The attack, confirmed by a source in the local hospital in the town of Tolosa, came one day after a Supreme Court judge was shot dead in Madrid and a car bomb killed an employee of a military base in Granada. The government blamed both attacks on the Basque separatist group ETA.
The dead man was identified as Francisco Arratibel.
Spanish news agencies said he had acted in the 1980s as an intermediary in negotiations between ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) and the family of a kidnap victim.
Several months later ETA planted a bomb at the door of his company but it did not explode, the reports said.
An Interior Ministry spokesman said he was checking the reports.
